'''Shuttle 81572''' was a [[Class type B/Legends|Class type B]] used by an elite [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|infiltrate]] the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
